stem:
Farah needs a way to mark equal intervals of time with no clock in the room.

Which process can be used to measure time?

options.text: Irregular handclaps, because any sound can mark time.
A pendulum that swings regularly, even if it has no clock face.
An old mechanical clock cannot measure time because it looks worn.
A regularly swinging pendulum without a numbered face cannot measure time.

teacher.key_rationale: Time can be marked by a repeating, regular process. A pendulum swing is that. Irregular claps miss regularity. A worn clock can still tick. A face is not required.
